budget_origin: Pre-run initial exposure v2: 262144 joint steps rounded up to whole rollout; not convergence or success criterion
selection_basis: All native actions categorical. Per-role native returns; no assumed shared team reward. Parameter sharing with explicit role index permits different role policies and bounds memory at up to 768 roles. Local observations only, no privileged critic.
memory_limit: Four local frames, feedforward; partial observation can require recurrent follow-up, not claimed sufficient.

task.objective: Use three beams and two reusable clamps to carry the single heavy crate from the west bank to within one cell of (8,3). Successful delivery rewards every role +1.
task.natural_termination: Delivery or any unsupported worker/cargo loss terminates. A simultaneous failure takes reward priority (-1 each). Otherwise 128 steps truncate.
task.interaction: Only the carpenter can reposition beams and only the rigger can engage clamps. A path to one clamped bank carries workers; paths to both banks carry cargo. A support edit therefore changes another role's movement opportunities and can cause immediate load failure.
task.observation_access: All positions, tool roles, inventories implied by ownership, structural support, clamps, cargo and event flags are public. Every entity is visible to every role; the live map is a public rendering of the exact support rule.

native_event_definitions.meaning: Successful carpenter/rigger/hauler tool use this transition
Installed beams that lost all clamped-bank connectivity this transition
Workers failing their actual post-edit support/load requirement this transition
Movement intents blocked by terrain/load/occupancy/shared targets

primary_metric: mean across roles of unmodified native episode returns; inspect role vector and task events, mean can cancel in competitive games
evaluation_policy: stochastic legal-action sampling; same independent seeds and native horizon for random/IPPO
selection_rule: No selection by evaluation; initial final checkpoint reported, every intermediate point retained
stop_rule: Complete frozen joint-step exposure. Stop safely for nonfinite values, native contract error, resource limit, or explicit coordinator/user instruction. Wall slices resume same identity.
scope: Existing Crucibles games only; does not implement original LLM/UED/meta-gradient experiment
